data.name: Abrahams
data.gender_notes: Abrahams is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In the Old Testament, Abraham is considered the father of the Jewish people. God promised him that his descendants would be as numerous as the stars in the sky and the grains of sand on the seashore. This name is a reminder of God's promise and Abraham's unwavering faith. The name Abrahams carries the meaning “Father of many nations” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Abrahams usually hope their child will grow to embody father of many nations and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes faith, obedience, and the promise of God's blessings.
data.etymology: Abrahams belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Father of many nations.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Abrahams total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_hebrew.name: אברהמס
in_hebrew.meaning: אב הרים, אב של המונים, הברית עם אלוקים
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם אברהמס מקורו בשם העברי אברהם, שפירושו אב הרים או אב של המונים. זהו שם בעל חשיבות רבה בתנ"ך, בו הובטח לאברהם כי יהיה לאב של המונים ושהוא יהיה היסוד לשושלת המלוכה והכוהנים. השם משקף את הברית בין אלוקים לאברהם ואת התפקיד המרכזי שלו בהיסטוריה של עם ישראל.

in_greek.name: Αβραάμς
in_greek.meaning: Πατήρ πλήθους, σύμφωνο με τον Θεό
in_greek.long_meaning: Ο όνομα Αβραάμς προέρχεται από το εβραϊκό όνομα Αβραάμ, που σημαίνει πατήρ πλήθους ή πατήρ πολλών. Στο Χριστιανισμό και την Ιστορία της Εκκλησίας, το όνομα συνδέεται με τον Αβραάμ της Βίβλου, στον οποίο υποσχέθηκε ο Θεός να κάνει πατέρα πολλών εθνών και να του δώσει τη γη της Χαναάν ως κληρονομιά. Το όνομα αντανακλά τη συμφωνία και τη σχέση του Αβραάμ με τον Θεό.

in_latin.name: Abrahams
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Abrahams derivatur ex hebraeo nomine Abraham, quod significat patrem multitudinis vel patrem multorum. In traditione christiana, nomen Abrahams refertur ad Abrahamum biblicum, cui Deus promisit se facturum eum patrem multarum gentium et dans ei terram Canaan in hereditatem. Nomen significat foedus et relationem Abrahae cum Deo.

in_english.name: Abrahams
in_english.meaning: Father of many, covenant with God
in_english.long_meaning: The surname Abrahams is derived from the Hebrew name Abraham, meaning 'father of many' or 'exalted father.' It originates from the biblical figure Abraham, a central character in the Old Testament, with whom God made a covenant, promising to make him the father of many nations. The name Abrahams signifies a connection to this biblical heritage, reflecting themes of fatherhood, leadership, and divine promise. It carries spiritual significance in Christian tradition as a symbol of faith and divine covenant.

data.cultural_impact: Abraham is a significant figure in Judeo-Christian tradition and is considered the father of the Jewish people. His story of faith and obedience to God has been passed down through generations and continues to influence Jewish and Christian culture to this day.
data.spiritual_significance: The name "Abraham" holds a deep spiritual significance as it is a reminder of God's promise to make Abraham the father of a great nation. It serves as a testament to Abraham's unwavering faith and obedience to God, and is a reminder of the promise of God's faithfulness and providence.
